comment: Independent C-first B92 monster-to-hero AD_DRLI witness. The Wizard is raised to level 5 with the documented debug level command so one successful life drain is survivable, then creates a hostile wraith. The C probe showed the wraith adjacent and the second wait turn calls hitmu→mhitm_adtyping(AD_DRLI)→mhitm_ad_drli, passes the one-in-three and magic-negation gates, and loses one hero level; the input ends at that first successful drain.
